selection_timing: Declared after core and four structural-ablation results, before scoring the blend
hypothesis: The best structural ablation may complement character TF-IDF
design: One equal-weight soft average; no weight search; same frozen 8000/2000 split and sensitivity IDs
status: Exploratory adaptive extension; interval does not correct for earlier selection
promotion_rule: Recommend blend for Day 1 handoff only if full-holdout AUROC improves and the exploratory paired 95% interval lower bound exceeds zero; otherwise retain character core. This is a conservative selection heuristic, not confirmatory inference.
